steps.description: An 'O' region survives only if it touches the border. So first DFS from every border 'O' and mark what it reaches; afterwards, any interior 'O' left unmarked is surrounded and becomes 'X'.
(3,1) is an unvisited 'O' on the border, so its region is safe. dfs(3,1) marks all of it.
dfs(3,1): mark this 'O' visited - it is connected to the border.
dfs(3,1) is done. Return to the caller.
(1,1) is an 'O' no border DFS reached - it is surrounded. Flip it to 'X'.
(1,2) is an 'O' no border DFS reached - it is surrounded. Flip it to 'X'.
(2,2) is an 'O' no border DFS reached - it is surrounded. Flip it to 'X'.
3 surrounded 'O's were flipped to 'X'; every 'O' left touches the border through other 'O's.
